build_binding.binding_basis: Integrator supplied the rebuilt executable; this worker independently froze source/header/app/scripts and both executable identities. No rebuild or Git command was run.

interpretation: The initial independent-reference comparisons apply to these identical candidate bytes. No independent solve or comparison budget was recomputed or changed. No complete matrix, convergence, continuous-extrema coverage, or physical-fidelity claim follows.

manifest_comparison.explanation: Retain every manifest difference; only timestamp, producer identity, command producer paths, and aggregate audit path are expected to differ.

retention.policy: Complete stdout/stderr, commands, exits, errors, manifests and aggregate retained in the new build directory; raw candidate bytes not duplicated in this durable summary.
